comparison.objective: Grade apricots by size with a sizing board; candidate finishes four installed HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Fruit handling and sizing-ring classification versus narrow-mandrel alignment, controlled impact, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Title indicates size grading, but the body is empty and no specs or thresholds are provided. Candidate requires four fractures without insert/shell damage and recovery of every tang.
comparison.reason: Tests size-based produce grading rather than impact fracture of a manufactured notch.
